decisive_items: Shows a morning glory optic disc anomaly with low-lying detachment of the peripapillary retina
Visualization revealed a morning glory disc anomaly and a chronic retinal detachment
response.rationale: Morning glory syndrome accounts for the characteristic optic disc anomaly and its known complication of chronic retinal detachment; the aqueous crystals and hemorrhage are secondary cholesterol/vascular changes in a blind, chronically detached eye. Primary hyperoxaluria explains anterior-chamber crystals but not the pathognomonic morning glory disc anomaly.

rejected.why: It explains the anterior-chamber crystals but cannot account for the morning glory optic disc anomaly and chronic retinal detachment, which are the primary defining findings here.
